newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank sees key rates steady medium term.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank sees key rates steady medium term.

text.p: Austria's key interest rates are likely to remain unchanged over the medium term, Austrian central bank chief executive Adolf Wala said on Thursday.

"I think interest rates are at a historical low already and they will stay at that level in the next three to six months," Wala told a news conference on the occasion of the publication of the central bank's annual report.
Austria's discount rate stands at 2.50 percent, its emergency Lombard borrowing rate at 4.75 percent, and its Gomex money market rate at 3.40 percent.
